name: Design Referral Program
summary: Design a referral system with product fit, balanced incentives, fraud controls, and durable economics.
description: Design or audit a customer referral, affiliate, or ambassador program using product fit, participant value, consent, incentive economics, attribution, disclosure, fraud controls, and operational ownership. Use before launching or materially changing a referral system.
risk_reason: This skill designs a referral system with product fit, balanced incentives, fraud controls, and durable economics; it does not buy undisclosed endorsements, reviews, or testimonials.
refuses: It does not buy undisclosed endorsements, reviews, or testimonials.
It does not send invitations without participant action or ignore recipient suppression and consent.
It does not approve payouts, change balances, or claim the program is legally compliant.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs a referral system with product fit, balanced incentives, fraud controls, and durable economics, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
